title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-31 09:09:07 最新章节：第132章 不怕死就跳下去
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
“石泉水，你入门五十余年，如今仍未完成筑基，你还是早点下山吧。”
剑血宗山下，一个白须飘飘的孩童模样的老者捻着长须，摇起了头。
一队御剑而过的弟子，看到百花老人，一个个是扯开了嗓子嘲讽起来。
“师父。这就是那个跟您一起入宗门的活宝？”
“什么一起？我比他晚十年。”
“师父，他现在还是炼气一品？太夸张了吧？弟子天资愚钝，可入门一个月就达到炼气三品了。他是不是太那个了？”
“都记住，不好好修炼，就跟他一样。”
伴随着一声声的大肆嘲讽的远去，石泉水逐渐恢复了意识。
呃，我穿越了？
穿越到了修仙世界？
他低着头看着苍老的双手，第一个蹦出来的记忆是他的年龄。
从7岁拜入剑血宗，过了这几十年，再差的资质都能完成筑基。
但他的修为从7岁那年开始就原地踏步。
63岁？
我靠，别开玩笑了，别人穿越好歹是年轻。
我呢？
这个世界普通人寿命也就五六十岁，刚来就要埋入黄土了？
“差不多吧，以你身体的状况，还可以活三四年。”
石泉水听到这笑嘻嘻的女声，惊讶地抬起头。
白须男童的身后出现一个发光的巨大萝莉虚影，正冲他眨眼睛。

“你是......”
石泉水刚开口，就发现眼前的金护法一动不动，仿佛被定住了一般，一阵风吹来，他的胡须也没有随风而动。
“我是你的护法天使，你叫我萝莉，或者别的也可以。”
“萝莉？你？”
十几米高？
你让我喊你萝莉？
“是啊！”
萝莉话音刚落，她的身体迅速缩小，变成一个拇指大小的精灵，但她身体仍然是虚幻的。
“是你召唤我来的？”
石泉水弱弱的问道，他可不想死，连女朋友都没处过，这么死了，实在太不甘心了。
“是啊，不过你是第人，嗯......你之前的都因为失败，彻底死了！”
萝莉的语气中透露出一种无所谓的态度
彻底死了？
石泉水一听这几个字，头都要炸开了。
“真的会死人？”
他颤抖着声音问道，本来以为修炼不成说不定还能回去，好死不如赖活着吗。
萝莉在原地翻了个跟头，手里忽然多了一根法杖。
“我是阿利亚星球的学生，来这里是为了完成毕业论文。而你就是我的试验品。”
content_en:
"Shiquanshui, you have been here for more than fifty years and you still haven't completed the foundation building. You'd better come down the mountain as soon as possible."
At the foot of the Sword Blood Sect mountain, a child-like old man with fluttering white beard twirled his long beard and shook his head.
When a group of disciples passing by with swords saw Old Man Baihua, they all started taunting him at the top of their lungs.
"Master. Is this the living treasure who joined the sect with you?"
"What together? I am ten years behind him."
"Master, is he still at the first level of Qi Refining? Isn't that too exaggerated? The disciple has a dull talent, but he has reached the third level of Qi Refining in just one month. Isn't he too much?"
"Remember, if you don't practice well, you will be just like him."
As the loud taunts receded, Shi Quanshui gradually regained consciousness.
Uh, I traveled through time?
Traveled to the world of cultivating immortals?
He lowered his head and looked at his old hands, and the first memory that popped out was his age.
Became a member of the Sword and Blood Sect at the age of 7, and over the past few decades, he has been able to complete foundation building no matter how poor his qualifications are.
But his cultivation has been on the same level since he was 7 years old.
63 years old?
Damn it, don’t be kidding, others who time travel are still young.
What about me?
The lifespan of ordinary people in this world is only fifty or sixty years old. Are they going to be buried in the loess as soon as they come here?
"Absolutely. With your physical condition, you can live for another three or four years."
Shi Quanshui raised his head in surprise when he heard the smiling female voice.
A huge glowing loli shadow appeared behind the white-bearded boy, blinking at him.
"You are..."
As soon as Shi Quanshui opened his mouth, he found that the golden protector in front of him was motionless, as if he was frozen. A gust of wind blew, and his beard did not move with the wind.
"I am your guardian angel. You can call me Loli, or something else."
"Lori? You?"
Ten meters high?
You want me to call you Loli?
"Yes!"
As soon as Loli finished speaking, her body quickly shrank and turned into an elf the size of a thumb, but her body was still illusory.
"Did you summon me?"
Shi Quanshui asked weakly, he didn't want to die, he had never even had a girlfriend, so he was really unwilling to die like this.
"Yes, but you are the first person, well... all of your previous ones died completely because of failure!"
Loli's tone revealed an indifferent attitude
Completely dead?
When Shi Quanshui heard these words, his head almost exploded.
"Will people really die?"
He asked with a trembling voice. He originally thought that if he failed in his cultivation, he might be able to go back. Wouldn't it be better to live than to die?
Loli turned around on the spot, and suddenly there was a staff in her hand.
"I am a student from Planet Alia. I am here to complete my graduation thesis. And you are my test subject."
